ingenieria.fullContent:
At TechVibes we are experts in Project Engineering to improve the Quality standard of the projects we work on.

Why is Home Automation Engineering important?

1. Comprehensive design from the start
It allows coordination from the beginning of the necessary infrastructure (conduits, trays, technical spaces) with architects, civil and electrical engineers.

We design developments thought for current and future technologies, avoiding subsequent works or modifications.

domotica.title: Home Automation
domotica.description: Automation and centralized control of home systems from an app, tablet or voice control.
domotica.fullContent:
Home automation allows automating and centralizing the control of the different systems in the home, from an app or remote control (cell phone, tablet, voice control, Alexa, Google Home, etc). This provides comfort, security, energy efficiency and a fully personalized experience that includes Design, installation, configuration, support and after-sales service.

Unlike IOT (Internet of Things) systems, professional home automation has proactive monitoring of installed products, personalized after-sales service and constant system updates.

The service that TechVibes offers is not just product installation, but an immersive experience and the advantage that technology offers us to live better.

We invite you to our showroom so you can experience it for yourself.

red.title: Network / WiFi
red.description: Limitless connectivity. WiFi networks and telecommunications with total coverage and high speed.
red.fullContent:
Limitless connectivity with Techvibes

At Techvibes we design and implement WiFi networks and telecommunications solutions designed to provide total coverage, high speed and maximum stability. Whether in homes, offices or commercial spaces, we optimize each installation to guarantee an efficient, secure and uninterrupted connection.

We use state-of-the-art technology and carry out personalized studies to ensure that each environment has a powerful and constant signal, even in complex or large spaces.

Trust Techvibes to keep you always connected, with expert technical support that accompanies every stage of the project and its maintenance.

seguridad.title: Security
seguridad.description: Smart security with alarms, HD cameras and digital locks controlled from your phone.
seguridad.fullContent:
Smart security with Techvibes

At Techvibes we protect what matters most to you by integrating modern and efficient security systems. We install smart alarms, high-definition surveillance cameras and digital locks that you can control from your phone, wherever you are.

Our solutions adapt to homes, offices and businesses, and can be integrated with home automation systems for centralized and automated management. Each installation is carried out by professionals with extensive experience, guaranteeing quality, reliability and continuous technical support.

With Techvibes, security is smart, accessible and always under your control.

soporte.title: Technical Support
soporte.description: Over 10 years of experience. On-site and remote assistance with active technical on-call service.
soporte.fullContent:
Specialized Technical Support

At Techvibes we not only install cutting-edge technology, we also guarantee its optimal performance over time. We have a highly trained technical team with over 10 years of experience in home automation, professional audio systems and telecommunications.

We provide both on-site and remote assistance, adapting to each client's needs. Our online service allows us to resolve issues quickly, and our active technical on-call service ensures priority attention according to the contracted subscription level.

With Techvibes, the peace of mind of having experts available when you need them is part of the service.

For more information contact us at info@techvibes.com.ar

audioVideo.title: Audio & Video
audioVideo.description: Home Cinema and Multiroom Audio. Surround sound and music in every room of your house.
audioVideo.fullContent:
Live the Techvibes experience: Home Cinema and Multiroom Audio

At Techvibes we transform your home into a smart space where technology integrates elegantly and functionally. With our Home Cinema system, we bring the cinema experience to your living room: surround sound, high-definition images and total automation so you just have to sit back and enjoy.

Additionally, with our multiroom audio solutions, every room comes alive. Listen to your favorite music throughout the house or choose different content for each space, all controlled from an intuitive app or voice commands.

Choose Techvibes and turn your home into a more comfortable, modern and connected place.
